personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT (with Material You expressive structural layout)
personality_one_liner: A calm, editorial personal archive for links, notes, reminders, and self-messages with zero account friction.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial padding with comfortable vertical rhythm and touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use clean paper-white and cream editorial surfaces
Rely on typography and generous whitespace for hierarchy
dont's: No heavy glass blurs that interfere with reading flow
No neon colors or saturated gradients

screens.name: Daily Inbox
screens.purpose: Unified feed of today's reminders, shared links, saved notes, and quick self-messages.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with warm brand terracotta tone
states.empty: Editorial empty state with notebook illustration and quick capture prompt
states.error: Warm red error banner with readable retry action

screens.layout: Header with app title 'Recall', search bar, and quick filter chips (All, Links, Reminders, Notes, Voice). Sectioned feed with Today's Reminders card, shared link cards with scraped metadata preview, and quick self-message input.

screens.name: Capture & Add
screens.purpose: Manual creation and Android Sharesheet ingestion hub for links, voice snippets, checklists, and text notes.

states.loading: Saving state indicator with check animation
states.empty: Select a content type to begin capturing
states.error: Failed to parse metadata or save snippet; tap to retry

screens.layout: Tabbed entry selector (Link, Note, Checklist, Voice/Text), URL auto-fetch card with scraped title/image preview, folder & label selector, and bottom sticky Save button.

screens.name: Archive & Search
screens.purpose: Full-text search, folder management, pinned items, and archive browsing.

states.empty: No saved items match your query. Try searching by keyword or folder.
states.error: Index read error; tap to rebuild search index

screens.layout: Sticky search header with instant filter pills, Folders horizontal shelf, Pinned section, and categorized item list with swipe actions (Pin, Archive, Delete).

screens.name: Reminders Hub
screens.purpose: Manage one-time, repeating, and location-based (arrive/leave) reminders like WhatsApp self-messages.

states.empty: No active reminders set. Tap '+' to create one.
states.error: Location service or notification permission error; tap to configure

screens.layout: Segmented control (Upcoming, Completed, Location-based), grouped reminder cards with repeat badges and location trigger toggles, sticky primary action button.

screens.name: Settings & Export
screens.purpose: Manage local database backup, export to JSON/Markdown, notification permissions, and app preferences.

states.error: Export failed; ensure storage permission is granted

screens.layout: Grouped setting rows with icon containers, local storage usage stats, Export/Backup buttons, and app version info.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build 'Recall' as a polished Android app using React Native / Expo with TypeScript, following the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality combined with Material You expressive layout patterns.
Implement zero-account local on-device persistence (AsyncStorage / SQLite) for links, notes, images, checklists, and voice snippets.
Support Android Sharesheet receiver simulation, link metadata extraction (OpenGraph title, image, description), and manual paste.
Provide Google Keep-like features: folders, labels, pinning, archive, full-text search, and daily inbox view.
Implement comprehensive reminder scheduling: one-time, repeating, and location-based (arrive/leave location triggers) with local notifications.
Adhere strictly to touch targets >= 44pt, safe area insets, loading/empty/error states on all screens, and zero banned colors (no indigo, no purple, no navy blue).
Use Playfair Display for headings and DM Sans for body text. Max font weight 500.
